sentences.text: Miguel es médico.
sentences.english: Miguel is a doctor.

sentences.text: Viene de México para trabajar con la brigada de octubre.
sentences.english: He is coming from Mexico to work with the October brigade.

sentences.text: Su primera tarea es dar una lección de salud en el colegio del pueblo.
sentences.english: His first task is to give a health lesson at the high school in the village.

sentences.text: Un martes, Miguel mandó un correo al grupo del equipo.
sentences.english: One Tuesday, Miguel sent an email to the team group.

sentences.text: «Mi vuelo llega el miércoles a las diez de la mañana.
sentences.english: "My flight arrives on Wednesday at ten in the morning.

sentences.text: ¿Quién me recibe en el aeropuerto?»
sentences.english: Who will meet me at the airport?"

sentences.text: Sam contestó: «Yo te recibo.
sentences.english: Sam answered: "I will meet you.

sentences.text: Luis nos presta su carro.»
sentences.english: Luis is lending us his car."

sentences.text: Sam prometió devolver el carro el jueves.
sentences.english: Sam promised to return the car on Thursday.

sentences.text: Miguel respondió con una foto de su familia.
sentences.english: Miguel replied with a photo of his family.

sentences.text: Miguel desea conocer a todos, escribió.
sentences.english: He wrote that he wants to meet everyone.

sentences.text: El miércoles, Sam y Luis llegaron temprano al aeropuerto.
sentences.english: On Wednesday, Sam and Luis arrived early at the airport.

sentences.text: Luis le preguntó a una señora: —¿Cuándo llega el vuelo de México?
sentences.english: Luis asked a lady, "When does the flight from Mexico arrive?"

sentences.text: —Tiene un retraso de una hora —respondió ella.
sentences.english: "It has a one-hour delay," she answered.

sentences.text: —Gracias —dijo Luis—.
sentences.english: "Thank you," said Luis.

sentences.text: Le agradezco mucho.
sentences.english: "I am very grateful."

sentences.text: —Les deseo un buen día —dijo la señora.
sentences.english: "I wish you a good day," said the lady.

sentences.text: Sam y Luis decidieron esperar sentados en el aeropuerto.
sentences.english: Sam and Luis decided to wait seated in the airport.

sentences.text: Hablaron del viaje de Miguel.
sentences.english: They talked about Miguel's trip.

sentences.text: —Después de muchas horas de vuelo, Miguel necesita descansar —dijo Sam.
sentences.english: "After many hours of flying, Miguel needs to rest," said Sam.

sentences.text: Por fin Miguel salió.
sentences.english: At last Miguel came out.

sentences.text: Tenía una camisa blanca, un pantalón azul, zapatos negros y una bolsa grande.
sentences.english: He had a white shirt, blue pants, black shoes and a big bag.

sentences.text: —¡Qué gusto verte! —dijo Sam, y lo abrazó.
sentences.english: "How good to see you!" said Sam, and hugged him.

sentences.text: Miguel mostró su pasaporte a un señor y entró al país.
sentences.english: Miguel showed his passport to a man and entered the country.

sentences.text: —Mi pasaporte está en el pantalón, no en la bolsa —dijo.
sentences.english: "My passport is in my pants, not in the bag," he said.

sentences.text: —¿Cómo fue el vuelo? —preguntó Luis.
sentences.english: "How was the flight?" asked Luis.

sentences.text: —Fue un vuelo de muchas horas, pero estoy contento.
sentences.english: "It was a flight of many hours, but I am happy.

sentences.text: Ahora quiero descansar.
sentences.english: Now I want to rest."

sentences.text: Los tres salieron del aeropuerto y fueron al carro de Luis.
sentences.english: The three left the airport and went to Luis's car.

sentences.text: Pero el carro se rompió en la calle.
sentences.english: But the car broke down in the street.

sentences.text: —¡Qué mal! —dijo Luis—.
sentences.english: "How bad!" said Luis.

sentences.text: El mecánico está lejos.
sentences.english: "The mechanic is far away."

sentences.text: Sam llamó a Carlos.
sentences.english: Sam called Carlos.

sentences.text: Carlos prometió arreglarlo por la noche.
sentences.english: Carlos promised to fix it during the night.

sentences.text: El carro se quedó en la calle, y los tres decidieron viajar en autobús.
sentences.english: The car stayed in the street, and the three decided to travel by bus.

sentences.text: Miguel nunca viajó en autobús en Honduras.
sentences.english: Miguel had never traveled by bus in Honduras.

sentences.text: Todos entraron a la terminal.
sentences.english: They all went into the terminal.

sentences.text: Un señor dijo: —El autobús del pueblo tiene dos horas de retraso.
sentences.english: A man said, "The bus to the village has a two-hour delay."

sentences.text: —¿Por qué? —preguntó Sam.
sentences.english: "Why?" asked Sam.

sentences.text: El señor explicó que hubo una inundación en la calle.
sentences.english: The man explained that there was a flood in the street.

sentences.text: —Lo siento —dijo—.
sentences.english: "I am sorry," he said.

sentences.text: Les ofrezco agua mientras esperan.
sentences.english: "I offer you water while you wait."

sentences.text: Sam preguntó muy amable: —Señor, ¿puede avisarnos cuándo llega el autobús?
sentences.english: Sam asked very kindly, "Sir, can you let us know when the bus arrives?"

sentences.text: —Claro que sí —respondió el señor.
sentences.english: "Of course," answered the man.

sentences.text: Mientras esperaban, Miguel mostró una foto de su familia en el celular.
sentences.english: While they waited, Miguel showed a photo of his family on his phone.

sentences.text: Tiene una esposa y dos hijos pequeños.
sentences.english: He has a wife and two small children.

sentences.text: En la foto, su hijo juega con una pelota.
sentences.english: In the photo, his son is playing with a ball.

sentences.text: —Mi familia va a venir en diciembre —dijo—.
sentences.english: "My family is going to come in December," he said.

sentences.text: Mi esposa quiere conocer Honduras.
sentences.english: "My wife wants to see Honduras."

sentences.text: —Va a ser una fiesta —dijo Luis—.
sentences.english: "It's going to be a party," said Luis.

sentences.text: Doña Marta va a cocinar tamales.
sentences.english: "Doña Marta is going to cook tamales."

sentences.text: Miguel buscó su bolsa grande y no la encontró.
sentences.english: Miguel looked for his big bag and did not find it.

sentences.text: —Mi bolsa no está —dijo—.
sentences.english: "My bag is not here," he said.

sentences.text: Tiene camisetas, camisas, zapatos y un vestido para los niños de la brigada.
sentences.english: "It has T-shirts, shirts, shoes and a dress for the children of the brigade."

sentences.text: Miguel va a usar todo en la brigada.
sentences.english: Miguel is going to use it all in the brigade.

sentences.text: Sam y Luis buscaron en toda la terminal.
sentences.english: Sam and Luis looked all over the terminal.

sentences.text: Luis habló con una señora: —¿Vio usted una bolsa grande y azul?
sentences.english: Luis spoke with a lady: "Did you see a big blue bag?"

sentences.text: —No —dijo ella—.
sentences.english: "No," she said.

sentences.text: Pero hable con el señor de la terminal.
sentences.english: "But talk to the man at the terminal."

sentences.text: Un niño tenía la bolsa y jugaba con ella.
sentences.english: A boy had the bag and was playing with it.

sentences.text: Su mamá se puso roja.
sentences.english: His mom turned red.

sentences.text: —Lo siento mucho —dijo la mamá—.
sentences.english: "I am very sorry," said the mom.

sentences.text: Mi hijo pensó que era para él.
sentences.english: "My son thought it was for him."

sentences.text: —Mi pasaporte y mi dinero están conmigo —dijo Miguel—.
sentences.english: "My passport and my money are with me," said Miguel.

sentences.text: Gracias a Dios.
sentences.english: "Thank God."

sentences.text: Miguel abrió la bolsa para mostrar lo que tenía.
sentences.english: Miguel opened the bag to show what it had.

sentences.text: Había una caja con pastillas y muchas camisetas.
sentences.english: There was a box with pills and many T-shirts.

sentences.text: Miguel probó una camiseta al niño.
sentences.english: Miguel tried a T-shirt on the boy.

sentences.text: Le quedó bien.
sentences.english: It fit him well.

sentences.text: —Esta camiseta es para ti —dijo—.
sentences.english: "This T-shirt is for you," he said.

sentences.text: Quiero regalarte esta camiseta.
sentences.english: "I want to give you this T-shirt."

sentences.text: Mientras esperaban, una niña llegó llorando.
sentences.english: While they waited, a girl came crying.

sentences.text: Tenía una herida en la rodilla, y una mosca estaba cerca.
sentences.english: She had a wound on her knee, and a fly was nearby.

sentences.text: Miguel era médico.
sentences.english: Miguel was a doctor.

sentences.text: Decidió descansar después.
sentences.english: He decided to rest afterwards.

sentences.text: Miró la herida y la trató con agua y jabón.
sentences.english: He looked at the wound and treated it with water and soap.

sentences.text: —No es una herida grande —dijo—.
sentences.english: "It is not a big wound," he said.

sentences.text: Va a sufrir un poco, pero luego va a estar bien.
sentences.english: "She will suffer a little, but then she will be fine."

sentences.text: Otro niño se quemó la lengua con el café de su papá.
sentences.english: Another boy burned his tongue with his dad's coffee.

sentences.text: Miguel le dio agua fría.
sentences.english: Miguel gave him cold water.

sentences.text: A Miguel le dolía el hombro, y se rompió una uña.
sentences.english: Miguel's shoulder hurt, and a nail broke.

sentences.text: —¿Es un hueso? —preguntó Luis.
sentences.english: "Is it a bone?" asked Luis.

sentences.text: —No, es solo el hombro —dijo Miguel—.
sentences.english: "No, it's just the shoulder," said Miguel.

sentences.text: Y la rodilla de la niña está mejor que mi uña.
sentences.english: "And the girl's knee is better than my nail."

sentences.text: El autobús llegó con tres horas de retraso.
sentences.english: The bus arrived with a three-hour delay.

sentences.text: Los tres viajaron toda la noche.
sentences.english: The three traveled all night.

sentences.text: Miguel descansó.
sentences.english: Miguel rested.

sentences.text: Luis recibió un mensaje de Carlos: el carro ya estaba arreglado.
sentences.english: Luis received a message from Carlos: the car was already fixed.

sentences.text: Doña Marta los esperaba con café y pan.
sentences.english: Doña Marta was waiting for them with coffee and bread.

sentences.text: Miguel entró a la casa y se sentó.
sentences.english: Miguel entered the house and sat down.

sentences.text: En el colegio, Miguel quiere enseñar a los alumnos a cuidar su salud.
sentences.english: At the high school, Miguel wants to teach the students to take care of their health.

sentences.text: Sam compartió una foto en el grupo: «Miguel ya llegó.»
sentences.english: Sam shared a photo in the group: "Miguel has arrived."

sentences.text: El jueves por la mañana, Sam cumplió y devolvió el carro a Luis.
sentences.english: On Thursday morning, Sam kept his word and returned the car to Luis.

sentences.text: —Les agradezco todo —dijo Miguel—.
sentences.english: "I thank you for everything," said Miguel.

sentences.text: Quiero desearles buenas noches.
sentences.english: "I want to wish you a good night."
